name: gl-transitions
title: gl-transitions
description: Adds image and video transitions — fades, wipes, zooms, glitches, page curls — from the gl-transitions collection of 125 GLSL shaders, with SkSL, GLSL ES 3.00, WGSL and Metal versions where they translate. Covers picking a transition from the catalog and wiring it into WebGL, WebGPU, Skia, Remotion, FFmpeg and native stacks; shaders and catalog come from the npm package or jsdelivr.
why: The collection's only shader-transition skill: GSAP animates DOM timelines, but crossfades between images, clips and scenes in shader pipelines need exactly this catalog-plus-integration know-how, and the skill is doc-only with no scripts to trust.
